meta.name: RTSH TANI
meta.basis: Reverse-derived from this repo's EXISTING theme (src/theme/colors.ts, spacing.ts, borders.ts, fonts.ts) per Standing Rule 6 — the house palette is spec, so nothing here was re-picked. Colour keys mirror the ThemeColors interface 1:1 so the contract round-trips. Two documented deviations from the generic contract, both deliberate: (1) space/radius keys are PIXEL-VALUED, not scale steps, because that is what SPACING/BORDERRADIUS already name and renaming them would break the mapping; (2) type.family.sans names Inter first (the real loaded family, @expo-google-fonts/inter) with a system fallback, because the prototype must render with no network. Values are the phone-scale 1x baseline — scaled() in @/responsive applies the tablet/TV step, never baked in here.
meta.notes: RESOLVED 2026-08-10 — focus no longer equals primary. It was #EB122F (=== primary) through 2026-08-09, which made the ring an invisible red-on-red border on every primary-filled control, i.e. unoperable on a pointerless device. Fixed at the TOKEN (the second of the two candidates in rules/ARCHITECTURE.md), because the per-call-site fix repeats the bug on the next primary-filled control. Chosen after confirming the blast radius is TV-ONLY: all 27 consumers of colors.focus go through tvFocusHighlight (returns undefined off-TV), TVNavButton (returns null off-TV) or ProgramRow's focused branch (only ever true on TV) — so phone and tablet render identically. White was already the value every hand-fixed call site had converged on (RadioPlayer, AdOverlay); this promotes it to the token and the RadioPlayer override was removed. verify.sh gate G now passes. STILL OPEN: this repo has no motion token file, so `motion` is deliberately absent rather than invented; decide it during 22.18, since anxheloo-expo-motion (#22) consumes it.

family.sans: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
